Definition: properly, to cut off, i.e. (figuratively) detest
BiblicalUsage: 1) to loathe, be grieved, feel a loathing; 1a) (Qal) to feel a loathing; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to feel loathing against self; 1b2) to detest; 1c) (Hithpolel) to loathe oneself
